findings: Original complete verifier and unchanged supplemental replay demand closed.passed and disallow native_reused resource candidates. The registered owner-registration transition only replaces the owner preparation assertion; it does not add support for these other cases.

Raw v1 also demands closed.passed, disallows native_reused, and enumerates every endpoint_vector.json as a completed state. A failed evaluation can contain a vector without completion; its presence does not authorize quality admission.

The registered baseline queue waits for raw queue completion existence and owner termination, independently of all_roles_admitted. Preserve that actual scheduling policy. Quality failure must remain explicit, not hide or block unrelated registered mechanism execution.

Therefore queued completion must not be described as sufficient for an admitted LSTM complete pair. Existing frozen verifiers execute unchanged. Preserve their first actual failure; any later independent reconciliation must bind exact existing native reuse provenance, distinguish infrastructure failure from legitimate rejection, and report final physical quality separately from clean full-method confirmation/time. No historical completion is rewritten.
followup_trigger: Actual registered verifier terminal or new substantive anomaly; do not repoll ordinary candidate leaves or create redundant audit queues.
